label: 18:00 Southwell
race: Awc Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (Gbb/Gbbplus Race) (Class 3) (AllWeather) 3YO+ 1m 4f 14y Winner: £6,480 (9 runners)
note: DANSEUSE's debut third at Newcastle in May has worked out well so she could be worth chancing on her first run since. It shouldn't be too long before Bintnaseefa and Maneater are winning one of these so are obvious threats, while Don't Hurry Love is worth a second look on her belated return.

runners.tf_comment: Placed 5 of her 6 starts but she's consistent rather than progressive and looks vulnerable for the win once again.

Teofilo filly who is a first foal of a 1¼m/10.7f winner (sister to very smart winner up to 1¾m Ispolini). Strong in the betting and showed plenty amidst greenness in Newcastle novice in May, beaten only by a couple who have improved a lot subsequently. Very interesting contender on first run since.

575,000 gns yearling, Camelot filly. Half-sister to smart 1½m-1¾m winner Shamida. Dam 1½m winner. Always behind after a very slow start at Newmarket 15 months ago but that was a very strong maiden and significant that powerful connections persevere, with longer trip sure to suit.

Shaped well in a couple of all-weather maidens last autumn and stepped up on that when chasing home a smart prospect at Newcastle on her belated return 11 days ago. Big shout if this doesn't come too soon.
Long-standing maiden who almost caused a shock in Lingfield handicap last time but she makes little appeal in this company.

Masar filly who knew a lot more second time up when fourth at Kempton 6 weeks ago, making the running but not going hard enough given her likely stamina. Needs to improve again but stiffer test will suit.
Maiden who deserves credit for her consistency but she has a bit to find with the principals here. Change of headgear.
Won a bumper for Dan Skelton with plenty in hand this summer but well held on hurdling debut next time and starts out for new yard in what looks a pretty useful maiden on Flat bow.
Went off too hard when 7 lengths third of 5 in maiden at Ripon on debut in April but performed in total contrast (soon labouring) at Goodwood following month and not seen since.

220,000 gns Sea The Stars filly who left her debut run in the spring well behind when beaten just over a length in Kempton novice 3 weeks ago, still raw and looking the best prospect in the field. Will go on improving and is well up to winning one of these.
